page_projects: Organize projects and sessions. Start music, voice or WAV processing; each path shows its prerequisites before running anything.
page_queue: Follow tasks and open their results. Tasks waiting for resources stay queued; you do not need to submit them again.
page_library: Listen, compare and organize project versions. Favorites, A/B comparison and the project choice serve different purposes. File actions lead to FX or the source version.
page_voice: Prepare voice synthesis and organize language profiles and authorized references. A profile does not generate audio: ask your agent after linking the engine.
page_fx: Choose a WAV, adjust effects and listen to a preview. Then render a full version and explicitly choose the file and destination to export. No AI engine required.
page_storage: Review disk usage and file protections. Discard moves authorized files to 30-day trash; restore and permanent deletion are separate decisions.
page_environment: Prepare or link the engines you want to use. Review installation, requirements and licenses before confirming. Audacity is optional and configured separately.
page_bridges: Prepare the agent connection and optionally an Audacity handoff. Registration requires reloading the client; a past handshake does not confirm the current conversation.
voiceRequired: Voice generation requires: a linked voice engine and a request from your agent.
voiceOptional: Optional: an authorized voice identity reference. Profiles can be organized before installation.
musicRequired: Music generation requires: a compatible engine and a connected agent.
editorOptional: Optional: Audacity for external editing. Library, FX and WAV copies work without it.
agentRequired: Agent requests require: connection registration and a client reload.
fxRequired: Processing requires: a WAV registered in the project.
fxOptional: No AI model, agent connection or Audacity required.
voiceStatusHelp: Link an existing installation or review a new installation below. Profiles organize the language and authorized references for your voices.
musicStatusHelp: Link an existing installation or review a new installation. The queue checks available resources before starting each task.
codexActionSummary: Allow Codex to use this Sonariel workspace and tools.
codexActionHelpLabel: What does preparing the connection do?
codexActionHelp: Registers the MCP server and installs the Sonariel skill for the local user. Backs up an existing Codex configuration and preserves other servers. Does not generate audio or open a conversation; reload the client afterwards.
codexWait: Wait for the local configuration to be saved. No audio is being generated.
codexNext: Reload or reopen Codex to load the tools. Registration is saved; the client must still confirm availability in this conversation.
codexErrorHelp: Review the error on this page. Connection is not confirmed; the existing configuration may have been preserved by the protection mechanism.
voiceLinkMissing: To verify, select the environment Python and the checkpoint folder.
voiceInstallMissing: To review, select a new installation folder.
workflowHelpText: Opening a path does not generate, install or download anything. The current client must confirm its MCP tools.
pythonHelp: Select Scripts/python.exe from an existing voice environment. Verification does not install packages or change that installation.
checkpointsHelp: The existing voice engine checkpoint folder. Required for linking; the cache used for a new installation is optional.
folderHelp: A dedicated folder outside repositories. Reviewing shows the installation plan; installation only starts after your explicit authorization.
musicBlockedHelp: This engine is not available in this adapter yet. Setup does not remove that restriction; choose an available compatible engine.
startByChoosing: Choose what you want to do. Its next step and prerequisites will appear here.
intent_music: Define musical direction and parameters in your Codex conversation. Sonariel runs the request locally and collects the results.
intent_voice: Work with Codex to define the text, language and vocal identity. Follow versions here and organize reusable profiles when needed.
intent_audio: Import a WAV, adjust its effects and export a new copy. You can complete this path entirely in the app.
chooseProjectFirst: First create a project or select an existing one. It groups the sessions, files and decisions for this work.
audioReady: With a project selected, import the file next. No AI engine setup is required.
engineReadyForRequest: A compatible engine is linked. Prepare your request and confirm the connection in your client.
engineNeededForRequest: Generation needs a compatible engine. Prepare it in the app or ask Codex to review the configuration.
voiceAgentIntro: Ask Codex for the speech and performance you want. It inspects the project and works with available profiles.
musicAgentIntro: Describe the music you want to Codex. It reads the project context, discusses parameters with you and uses available engines. Results appear in the queue and library.
requestCopied: Starter request copied. Paste it into your Codex conversation and add your intention; no task was started.
requestCopyError: Could not copy automatically. Open the request text and copy it manually.
agentOutcome: After a request runs, follow the queue and listen to versions in the library. Copying this text does not send data to the agent or start generation.
requestVoice: I want to produce speech: let us define the text, language and vocal identity.
requestTemplate: Use the Sonariel tools to work on project “{{name}}” (ID: {{id}}). {{task}} First inspect the project context, available engines and connection. Help me define the direction and parameters. Do not start generation, installation or downloads until I confirm.
voiceSetupChoice: Synthesis requires the engine. Ask Codex to review its preparation or choose manual setup below.
profilesChoice: Profiles store language and reusable references. Codex can organize them; manual creation is optional.
environmentChoice: What do you want to prepare?
environmentIntro: This is occasional preparation, not a step to repeat for every generation. Choose an action to see its fields.
manualSetupNote: You are setting up through the app. Codex can also inspect requirements; installations still require your authorization.
fxStart: Choose the file to process. Adjustments and export appear after the source.
fxNoSource: Import a WAV in the library or open one of your files in FX to start.
openImport: Import a file in the library
recommendedScope: Recommended from the maintainer’s local listening evaluation. It is a starting configuration, not a guarantee for every musical style. ACE-Step remains the baseline; compact stays the lighter default.
recommendedCosts: Requires {{ram}} GiB of available RAM to start. Optional {{gb}} GB model components, downloaded separately from the app; verified local files are reused.
recommendedNotLinked: Optional profile not linked. Review setup and model terms before choosing a download. No model will be downloaded automatically.
recommendedTechnical: Medium DiT FP32 + SAME-L decoder FP32 + T5Gemma FP16. Eight steps, CFG/APG 1, six CPU threads, batch 1. Stereo float32 WAV, 44.1 kHz. Text-to-audio only, 5–60 seconds; SAME-L source-audio encoding is not integrated. The approximately 5.75 GiB process peak observed for 30 seconds does not predict other runs.
recommendedRequest: Use Sonariel in project “{{name}}” (ID {{project}}). Discover the available MCP tools and consult music_recommendations_list for recipe {{recipe}}. Inspect project context and environment availability. Help me choose an original prompt, explicit seed and duration (5–60 s), then save a named preset with music_recommendation_save. Do not include private reference audio or switch to audio2audio: this profile supports text2audio only. Preserve the eight-step FP32/SAME-L recipe. Saving is not generation: review the preset and ask for explicit confirmation before submitting any job or downloading/installing models. Keep originals and report preset/job IDs.
